faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Everything you need to know about CareerForge AI.

q1.question: What is CareerForge AI?
q1.answer: CareerForge AI is an AI-powered career platform that helps you create ATS-standard resumes, generate cover letters, analyze job descriptions, optimize for ATS systems, and track your job applications — all in one place.

q2.question: Is CareerForge AI free to use?
q2.answer: Yes! We offer a generous free plan that includes 1 resume and 3 cover letters with basic templates, limited AI suggestions, and PDF export. Upgrade to Pro for unlimited access to all features.

q3.question: What does ATS-standard mean?
q3.answer: ATS stands for Applicant Tracking System — the software companies use to filter resumes. Our platform ensures your resume meets ATS formatting standards, uses the right keywords, and avoids common pitfalls that cause automatic rejection.

q4.question: Can I download my resume and cover letter as PDF?
q4.answer: Absolutely! All plans include PDF export for both resumes and cover letters. Your documents will be formatted perfectly for digital submission and printing, maintaining consistent styling across all devices.

q5.question: How does the job description analysis work?
q5.answer: Our AI analyzes job descriptions to identify key requirements, skills, and keywords. It then compares them against your resume to provide a match score and specific suggestions to improve your application's alignment with the role.

q6.question: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
q6.answer: Yes, you can cancel your subscription at any time with no questions asked. Your account will remain active until the end of your current billing period, and you can continue using the free plan afterwards.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: CareerForge AI ("we", "us", or "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our platform. Please read this policy carefully. By using CareerForge AI, you agree to the practices described in this Privacy Policy.

personal.title: Personal Information
personal.content: We collect personal information that you voluntarily provide when you register, use our services, or communicate with us. This includes your name, email address, password, job title, career level, country of residence, and any other information you choose to provide during onboarding or while using our platform.

usage.title: Usage Information
usage.content: We automatically collect information about your interactions with our platform, including pages visited, features used, time spent on each feature, document creation history, and navigation patterns. We also collect device information such as browser type, operating system, IP address, and device identifiers.

documents.title: Document Data
documents.content: When you create resumes, cover letters, or other documents, the content you input is processed by our AI systems. We store this content to provide our services, improve our AI models, and enable you to access and edit your documents. Your document data is encrypted at rest and in transit.

howWeUse.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
howWeUse.content: We use the information we collect for the following purposes: (a) to provide, maintain, and improve our services; (b) to process your requests and transactions; (c) to personalize your experience and deliver relevant content; (d) to communicate with you about your account, updates, and promotions; (e) to monitor and analyze usage patterns to improve our platform; (f) to detect, prevent, and address fraud, security issues, and technical problems; (g) to comply with legal obligations.

infoSharing.title: 3. Information Sharing and Disclosure
infoSharing.content: We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to third parties. We may share your information in the following limited circumstances: (a) with service providers who assist in operating our platform (hosting, analytics, email delivery) under strict confidentiality agreements; (b) to comply with legal requirements, court orders, or governmental requests; (c) to protect our rights, privacy, safety, or property, or that of our users or the public; (d) in connection with a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets, where your information would be transferred as part of such transaction.

dataSecurity.title: 4. Data Security
dataSecurity.content: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your personal information, including encryption at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.3), secure data centers with restricted access, regular security audits and vulnerability assessments, access controls and authentication mechanisms, and continuous monitoring for unauthorized access. However, no method of transmission over the Internet or electronic storage is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

dataRetention.title: 5. Data Retention
dataRetention.content: We retain your personal information for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide our services. If you delete your account, we will delete your personal information within 30 days, except where we are required to retain certain information by law or for legitimate business purposes. Anonymized and aggregated data may be retained indefinitely for analytical purposes.

yourRights.title: 6. Your Rights (GDPR & Applicable Laws)
yourRights.content: Depending on your location, you may have the following rights regarding your personal data: (a) Right of Access — You can request a copy of the personal data we hold about you. (b) Right to Rectification — You can request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data. (c) Right to Erasure — You can request deletion of your personal data ("right to be forgotten"). (d) Right to Restrict Processing — You can request that we limit how we use your data. (e) Right to Data Portability — You can request your data in a machine-readable format. (f) Right to Object — You can object to our processing of your data for certain purposes. (g) Right to Withdraw Consent — You can withdraw your consent at any time where we rely on consent to process your data. To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at privacy@careerforge.ai.

cookies.title: 7. Cookies and Tracking Technologies
cookies.content: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your experience. Essential cookies are necessary for the platform to function (authentication, session management, security). Analytics cookies help us understand how you use our platform (anonymized usage data). Preference cookies remember your settings (language, theme, layout preferences). You can manage your cookie preferences through your browser settings or our cookie consent banner. Please note that disabling certain cookies may affect the functionality of our platform.

consent.title: Cookie Consent Mechanism
consent.content: When you first visit CareerForge AI, we present a cookie consent banner that allows you to: (a) Accept all cookies; (b) Accept only essential cookies; (c) Customize your cookie preferences by category. Your choice is saved and can be updated at any time through your account settings. We respect your preferences and do not set non-essential cookies without your explicit consent. The consent banner will reappear if we introduce new cookie categories or if your consent preferences are older than 12 months.

thirdParty.title: 8. Third-Party Services
thirdParty.content: Our platform may contain links to third-party websites or integrate with third-party services (such as Google Sign-In and Apple Sign-In for authentication). We are not responsible for the privacy practices of these third-party services. We encourage you to read the privacy policies of any third-party services you access through our platform. When you use Sign in with Apple, Apple will share your name and email address with us in accordance with Apple's privacy policy.

children.title: 9. Children's Privacy
children.content: CareerForge AI is not intended for use by individuals under the age of 16. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If we learn that we have collected personal information from a child under 16, we will take steps to delete that information as quickly as possible.

international.title: 10. International Data Transfers
international.content: Your information may be transferred to and processed in countries other than your country of residence. We ensure appropriate safeguards are in place, including Standard Contractual Clauses approved by the European Commission, to protect your data during international transfers.

changes.title: 11. Changes to This Privacy Policy
changes.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any material changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page and updating the "Last updated" date. We may also send you an email notification if the changes are significant. Your continued use of the platform after any changes constitutes your acceptance of the updated policy.

dataBreach.title: 12. Data Breach Notification
dataBreach.content: In the event of a data breach that is likely to result in a risk to your rights and freedoms, we will notify you and the relevant supervisory authority within 72 hours of becoming aware of the breach, as required by applicable data protection laws. The notification will include the nature of the breach, the likely consequences, and the measures we have taken or propose to take to address the breach.

contact.content: If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us at: CareerForge AI, Privacy Team, Email: privacy@careerforge.ai
